Sourav explains his initial hesitation to attend the conference due to his technical background.
He describes the conference's value in exposing him to the practical applications and challenges of AI in asset management.
He introduces IBM's focus on AI and their recent release of AI OpenScale.

He concludes by highlighting the value of AI in providing insights and analyzing data in a timely manner.
